items.title: Albert Artigues Sr. Interview, 1961-12-15
items.q: I loaned it to Johnny Cutrera... Johnny used my horn for maybe...2 or 3 years

ctx.x: Uh...I was gonna ask you about something else too... You left Brindley and you said you quit...did you stop playing entirely? Yeah...I quit entirely... You just...put your horn aside...

Put my horn aside...and got away from it...and the next time I saw my horn... My little boy...Albert was about...3 or 4 years old...and he had it...I put one of the...the middle key...uh...key-eye...and jammed a clothespin in there... So I had to send the horn to the factory...and have it done over...I did have it gone over...and...after I got it back...I loaned it to Johnny Cutrera... Johnny used my horn for maybe...2 or 3 years...he had my horn...
